text.autoconfig.zzzbrbe.title: Better Recipe Book Configuration
text.autoconfig.zzzbrbe.option.expandedR: New Recipe Book UI (Not Yet Finished)
A larger recipe book with a new UI layout. Not functional yet, but you can take a look.
text.autoconfig.zzzbrbe.option.pinyinSea: Type pinyin in the search bar to find items directly. Inspired by REI.
text.autoconfig.zzzbrbe.option.saveRecip: Each tab remembers its own page: switching away and back returns to the page you left, and reopening the book does the same. Typing a search starts from page 1; clearing the search returns to the page you were browsing before searching. Lost when the game exits.
text.autoconfig.zzzbrbe.option.hideNoRec: Hide Objects of Workstations Without Recipe Books
text.autoconfig.zzzbrbe.option.recipeVie:
Hover over an item or a recipe-book recipe and press R/U (default) to view its crafting recipes and the recipes that use it as a material.
Disable this or rebind the keys when you want to use the item manager's own view feature.
text.autoconfig.zzzbrbe.option.pinKey.@T: Pin recipe-book recipes or tabs to the front page, and pop up the query object's preview.
text.autoconfig.zzzbrbe.option.showModNa: Shows the source mod of an item, similar to Jade.
text.autoconfig.zzzbrbe.option.rbip.enab: Aligns the vanilla recipe book tabs with the creative inventory. Reopen inventory to take effect.
text.autoconfig.zzzbrbe.option.hideIncom: Hide 3x3 Recipe Marks in Survival Recipe Book
text.autoconfig.zzzbrbe.option.partialCr: Removes the 'Show Craftable Only' button; craftable items will always be placed on the first page.
text.autoconfig.zzzbrbe.option.partialOn: Only Show Incomplete Recipes While Carrying
Incomplete recipes will no longer always be shown. Pick up an item to show the incomplete recipes related to it, keeping the UI cleaner.
text.autoconfig.zzzbrbe.option.partialMa: Recipes that have some materials in the inventory will be given a special texture.
text.autoconfig.zzzbrbe.option.settingsB: §eTip: §eIf you disable the following two options, you'll need Mod Menu to re-enable them.
text.autoconfig.zzzbrbe.option.scrolling: When reaching the end of the book, wrap around to the beginning (like JEI)
text.autoconfig.zzzbrbe.option.alternati: Show Alternative Recipes Only on Hover
Displays items instead of their recipes in the alternative list for easier viewing
text.autoconfig.zzzbrbe.option.newRecipe: Enables a small bounce animation when unlocking new items
text.autoconfig.zzzbrbe.option.showAllRe: Show 3x3 Recipes in Survival Recipe Book
text.autoconfig.zzzbrbe.option.newRecipe: When enabled, automatically unlocks all recipes, allowing them to be viewed in the recipe book without discovery. Takes effect on the next world load.
text.autoconfig.zzzbrbe.option.scrollAro: When reaching the end of the book, wrap around to the beginning (like JEI)
text.autoconfig.zzzbrbe.option.keepCente: Keeps the crafting screen centered on your display while the recipe book is open.
text.autoconfig.zzzbrbe.option.hideReiJe: Hides the item manager (REI/JEI) overlays while inside a container screen.
text.autoconfig.zzzbrbe.option.settingsB: Shows a button inside the recipe book that opens the configuration screen.
text.autoconfig.zzzbrbe.option.enableBoo: The recipe book is hidden when disabled.
zzzbrbe.gui.tip.1: You can right-click the search bar to clear its text.
zzzbrbe.gui.tip.2: Press A (default) to pin the recipe under your cursor to the front page.
zzzbrbe.gui.tip.3: Incomplete recipes are those that have some materials in your inventory but cannot be crafted.
zzzbrbe.gui.tip.4: Using it with an item manager is also great — you can look up how to craft recipes and their uses in the recipe book (hotkeys follow your item manager). You can also hide the item manager's interface in "UI".
zzzbrbe.gui.tip.5: The creative mode tab feature comes from the Recipe Book is Pain mod!
zzzbrbe.gui.tip.6: Come say hi on social media and make some friends!
zzzbrbe.gui.tip.7: All code is generated by DeepSeek!
zzzbrbe.gui.tip.8: Hold Ctrl and click a page-turn button in the recipe area to jump straight to the first or last page.
zzzbrbe.gui.tip.9: To jump to a specific page in the recipe area: type "……" in the search bar, then the page number, then "……" again. ("……" can be replaced with "^")
text.autoconfig.zzzbrbe.option.recipeVie: Shows the recipes that produce this item.
text.autoconfig.zzzbrbe.option.usageView: Shows the recipes that use this item as a material or workstation.
